ruling: Maintainer FIX1 checkpoint ruling on PR #733 / 1f3f52724, 2026-09-09, item 2: CP-01/CP-09 sampling correction is accepted under Option-B discipline. Apply the identical sampler to MODEL and OURS for every size; preserve old readings as a secondary column. The pre-O22 tree must retain identical letter readings; thresholds and minimum fit counts do not change.
reason: The old 0.005 mm depth band can choose a below-apex vertex row on the smaller nose, moving the CP-01 crest chain. The fixed y >= nose - 0.5 mm exclusion can discard the smaller circle's lower tangent and starve CP-09. Neither is a geometric change.
crest: Select the actual minimum-depth vertex row, then that exact height row; no radius-derived aperture.
lower_face: Simplify collinear exact section splits at the existing coordinate precision; the longest lower straight face supplies its measured upper endpoint. Fit the original undercut formula to existing facing rows at or below that endpoint. A single facing plane keeps the original rear-plane rows. With a separate terminal plane, use actual horizontal triangle edges parallel to the initial face, one actual vertex per existing height; subtract both local profile depth and displacement along the face.
initial_facing: C9: walk the measured circular jaw from the mouth (at least four concyclic points at the existing 0.0001 mm coordinate precision), then take the first straight face. CP-02, CP-06 and CP-09 describe that ball-facing part. A separate CU-14 terminal return does not redefine the kernel face. No target angle or radius selects samples. A missing circular-jaw witness remains UNRESOLVED.
symmetry: One shared letters_sampling_621.mjs implementation for MODEL and OURS, all three sizes. The purchased 8-ft model is a single unscaled reference, re-evaluated for each size comparison; no side-specific tuning and no synthetic fit rows. Missing data remain UNRESOLVED.
secondary: Run the original FIX1 legacy sampling in the same process on the same meshes and record CP-01/CP-09 values, verdicts and identity-5 dependency as non-deciding secondary evidence. Also retain the pre-C9 actual-apex/back-plane-facing readings for CP-02, both CP-06 rows and CP-09; MODEL and OURS use the same implementation for both methods.
